text.es: Los clientes de Rascanya ensalzan la cercanía y dedicación de Jennifer en cada cita. Resaltan que las explicaciones sobre el mantenimiento del manto son claras y pedagógicas, generando un ambiente familiar donde dueños y perros se sienten atendidos con absoluta calma.
text.en: Pet owners in Rascanya praise Jennifer's warm demeanor and dedication during every appointment. They highlight her clear, practical advice regarding daily coat maintenance, creating an inviting environment where both dogs and handlers feel thoroughly looked after.

text.en: Reviews celebrate high technical proficiency in breed styling and the thorough removal of accumulated undercoat. Poodles and mixed breeds leave clean, soft, and neatly groomed, showcasing detailed trimming that enhances each dog's appearance without sacrificing comfort.

title.es: Afecto y calma con perros mayores

text.en: Pet parents deeply value the gentle patience shown toward senior dogs and first-time salon visitors. Knowing their companions receive soothing reassurance and necessary pauses throughout the session gives owners complete peace of mind during grooming appointments.

q.es: ¿Qué precios orientativos tienen los servicios básicos de baño y corte?
q.en: What are the starting rates for basic bathing and haircut services?
